commentary.text: 90+7' Robert Hartmann is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90+5' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the corner kick.
90+5' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90+1' Substitution. Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lukas Ullrich walks off.
90+1' Substitution. Kevin Stoger makes way for Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
90+1' Here is a change. Tim Kleindienst is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
90' Moritz Nicolas leaps to intercept the corner kick from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Robin Hack walks off the pitch to be replaced by Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
81' 1 - 2 Referee Robert Hartmann points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) goes wild in celebration.
81' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Robert Hartmann is going to take a look using VAR.
81' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
80' The substitution has been made. Yannik Keitel (VfB Stuttgart) has replaced Enzo Millot.
80' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen will be replaced by Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart).
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nathan Ngoumou as he is replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
75' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
75' The attendance for today's match is 55000.
73' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

72' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Moritz Nicolas inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
72' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexander Nubel intercepts the ball.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ermedin Demirovic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).
68' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
68' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

64' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
62' Yellow card. Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
59' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Jamie Leweling and he is replaced by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
59' The substitution is prepared. Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ameen Al Dakhil.
57' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card!
57' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) is booked by the referee.

56' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Alexander Nubel, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
56' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

53' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
49' 1 - 1 What bad luck! Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 1:1.

48' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Alexander Nubel anticipates well and smothers the ball.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
43' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
42' A yellow-coloured card is received by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
41' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

37' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
31' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
28' A cross from Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

25' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach). Julian Weigl plays a fantastic through ball and finds Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the roof of the net. It's now 0:1.

23' Stuttgart slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
22' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
20' The free kick from long range, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Referee Robert Hartmann sees the trip by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. B. Monchengladbach get a free kick.
15' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) heads on.
12' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
7' Alexander Nubel pulls off a great save to deny Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
5' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
4' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
2' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
1' The match has just started.
B. Monchengladbach will kick-off.
Robert Hartmann is the one to supervise the game today.
